# Fixam Career Pathways — Comprehensive Knowledge Base

## Platform Overview
Fixam Career Pathways (https://careerpath.usefixam.com) bridges the technical skill gap in Central Africa by training, certifying, and connecting blue-collar professionals with high-demand job opportunities across Cameroon.

## Ecosystem Integration
Graduates from Fixam Career Pathways automatically receive verified provider status on the primary Fixam On-Demand Service Marketplace (https://usefixam.com), accelerating their earnings and career growth.
